body.title: Integration cases: the daemon approve path and the real raw writers
body.summary: Add cases to src/daemon/__tests__/lifecycle-wiring.test.ts and the tests of the real raw writers: an approved artifact redrafted by a raw content write is approved again through the daemon approve handler and reviewed through the review-decision step, with the adopted entry in the log; the design-run writer's redraft of an approved LLD (the synthesize path) and a resolve-comment revise are carried through approval.
acceptanceChecks: An approved artifact redrafted by a raw content write is approved again through the daemon approve handler; the log holds the adopted entry and the head is approved at the new revision
The review-decision step records its review on a redrafted head at the new revision, with no head-ahead-of-log
A redraft by the design-run writer and a revise by resolve-comment each end approved through the service
